items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jim Hall? [INTERVIEWEE] No. It will come to me before— I certainly hope so.

ctx.x: They know they’re stuck. And you get there, and they’re waiting for you. So you give them the best that you can and they give you their best too. That’s the appreciative part about it. And I find that the audiences in Europe are just exceptional also, because they know your history. They know you, you know, sometimes even better than you know what you’ve done, you know? You go over there and they say well, “I got that record that you did with the two guitar players.” And I say well gee that’s been so long. I did…
No. It will come to me before— I certainly hope so. The guitar player that was with Fats Waller. Are you familiar with him?
